verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a prebuilt n8n, Zapier, or other no-code automation connector. Webhooks, API clients, the CLI and the MCP server are developer building blocks or separate capabilities, not a prebuilt no-code connector. The homepage line 'integrate your apps and agents' is too vague to count as evidence of one.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the scraping API to no-code automation platforms like n8n or Zapier through a prebuilt connector
